result.summary: The screen appears mostly functional, but there is an issue with content truncation in the navigation area and a minor layout inconsistency.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' and the partially visible category chip next to it are missing appropriate padding or spacing from the right edge of the screen, causing the cut-off to look abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal padding or spacing of the category list container to ensure the items have consistent visual breathing room before being truncated.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar labels (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) have very low contrast against the background, and the 'Profile' icon is positioned closer to the edge than the 'Home' icon.
issues.suggestion: Improve the contrast of the navigation text and ensure symmetrical padding in the bottom navigation bar for a cleaner layout.
